Caustic Downpour.name: Caustic Downpour
Caustic Downpour.description: The user flings a spray high overhead and it comes down as a fine, stinging rain over a street-wide area, only where they aim it. Every enemy beneath takes corrosive damage, and their worn armor, shields and support gear pit and sag: until repaired, that gear no longer protects them or works. Bystanders outside the aimed area stay dry. Strain: heavy.
